auth.description:
1. Sign in to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/).
  2. Create a new project or you can use existing one.
  3. Go to **APIs & Services** and click **Enable APIs & Services**.
  4. Search for **Google Search Console API** in the search bar and enable it.
  5. Go to **OAuth consent screen** and select **External** type and click create.
  6. Fill App Name, User Support Email, and Developer Contact Information. Click on the Save and Continue button.
  7. Click on **Add or Remove Scopes** and add following scopes and click update.
     - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters
  8. Click Save and Continue to finish the Scopes step.
  9. Click on the Add Users button and add a test email You can add your own email)
.Then finally click Save and Continue to finish the Test Users portion.
  10. Go to **Credentials**. Click on the **Create Credentials** button and select the **OAuth client ID** option.
  11. Select the application type as **Web Application** and fill the Name field.
  12. Add https://cloud.activepieces.com/redirect in **Authorized redirect URIs** field, and click on the Create button.
  13. Copy **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.

startDate.description: The start date of the date range to query (in YYYY-MM-DD format).

endDate.description: The end date of the date range to query (in YYYY-MM-DD format).

dimensions.description: The dimensions to group results by. Valid values: "query", "page", "country", "device", "searchAppearance", "date", "hour".

searchType.description: Filter results by search type. Defaults to "web".

filters.description: Optional filters to apply to the data. All filters are AND-ed together.

expression.description: The value to compare against. For "country" use ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (e.g. "ind"). For "device" use DESKTOP, MOBILE, or TABLET.

aggregationType.description: How data is aggregated. Defaults to "auto".

rowLimit.description: The maximum number of rows to return. Min: 1, Max: 5,000. Defaults to 1,000.

startRow.description: Zero-based index of the first row to return. Use with Row Limit to paginate results. Defaults to 0.

aiMetadata.description: Query Google Search Console search-performance metrics (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) for a verified site over a date range, optionally grouped by dimensions (query, page, country, device, searchAppearance, date, hour), filtered by search type, and narrowed with dimension filters.   5. Ga naar het **OAuth toestemming scherm** en selecteer **External** type en klik op maken.

     - https://www.googleapis. om/auth/webmasters

. hen klik eindelijk op Opslaan en doorgaan om de test users portie te voltooien.
  10. Ga naar **Aanmeldingen**. Klik op de knop **Credentials** en selecteer de optie **OAuth client ID**.
  11. Selecteer het applicatie type als **Web Applicatie** en vul het veld Naam in.
  12. Voeg https://cloud.activepieces.com/redirect toe in **Authorized redirect URI's** veld, en klik op de Creëer-knop.

  2. Erstellen Sie ein neues Projekt oder Sie können ein bestehendes Projekt verwenden.
  3. Gehen Sie zu **APIs & Services** und klicken Sie auf **APIs & Services**.
  4. Suche nach **Google Search Console API** in der Suchleiste und aktiviere diese.
  Gehe zum **OAuth consent screen** und wähle **External** Typ und klicke auf Erstellen.
  6. Geben Sie App-Name, Benutzer-Support-E-Mail und Entwickler-Kontaktinformationen ein. Klicken Sie auf die Schaltfläche Speichern und fortfahren.

. hen klicken Sie schließlich auf Speichern und fortfahren, um den Test User Teil zu beenden.

  12. Fügen Sie https://cloud.activepieces.com/redirect im Feld **Autorisierte Weiterleitungs-URIs** hinzu und klicken Sie auf den Erstellen-Button.

1. Sign in to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/).
  2. Create a new project or you can use existing one.
  3. Go to **APIs & Services** and click **Enable APIs & Services**.
  4. Search for **Google Search Console API** in the search bar and enable it.
  5. Go to **OAuth consent screen** and select **External** type and click create.
  6. Fill App Name, User Support Email, and Developer Contact Information. Click on the Save and Continue button.
  7. Click on **Add or Remove Scopes** and add following scopes and click update.
     - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters
  8. Click Save and Continue to finish the Scopes step.
  9. Click on the Add Users button and add a test email You can add your own email)
.Then finally click Save and Continue to finish the Test Users portion.
  10. Go to **Credentials**. Click on the **Create Credentials** button and select the **OAuth client ID** option.
  11. Select the application type as **Web Application** and fill the Name field.
  12. Add https://cloud.activepieces.com/redirect in **Authorized redirect URIs** field, and click on the Create button.
  13. Copy **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.

ja.Removes a site from the set of the user': ユーザのSearch Consoleサイトのセットからサイトを削除します。
ja.Use the URL Inspection action to check t: URL 検査アクションを使用して、Google の索引内の特定のページの状態と存在を確認します。
ja.Make a custom API call to a specific end: 特定のエンドポイントへのカスタム API コールを実行します。

ja.The start date of the date range to quer: 問い合わせる日付範囲の開始日 (YYYY-MM-DD形式)。
ja.The end date of the date range to query: 問い合わせる日付範囲の終了日 (YYYY-MM-DD形式)。
ja.The dimensions to group results by. Vali: 結果をグループ化するための次元。有効な値："クエリ"、"ページ"、"国"、"デバイス"、"検索外観"、"日付"、"時間"。
ja.Filter results by search type. Defaults: 検索タイプで結果をフィルタリングします。デフォルトは "web" です。
ja.Optional filters to apply to the data. A: データに適用する任意のフィルタ。すべてのフィルタはAND型にまとめられます。
ja.How data is aggregated. Defaults to \"au: データが集計される方法。デフォルトは "auto" です。
ja.The maximum number of rows to return. Mi: 返される行の最大数。最小: 1, 最大: 5,000。デフォルトは1,000。
ja.Zero-based index of the first row to ret: 返される最初の行のゼロベースのインデックス。ページレートの結果を表示するには行数制限を使用します。デフォルトは0です。

pt.\n 1. Sign in to [Google Cloud Console]:
1. Entre no [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/).
  2. Crie um novo projeto ou você pode usar o já existente.
  3. Vá para **APIs & serviços** e clique **Habilitar APIs e serviços**.
  4. Pesquisar por **API do Console de Pesquisa do Google** na barra de pesquisa e habilitá-lo.
  5. Vá para **OAuth consent screen** e selecione o tipo **externo** e clique em criar.
  6. Preencha o nome do aplicativo, e-mail de suporte ao usuário e informações de contato do desenvolvedor. Clique no botão Salvar e Continuar.
  7. Clique em **Adicionar ou Remover Escopo** e adicione os seguintes escopos e clique em atualizar.
     - https://www.googleapis. om/auth/webmasters
  8. Clique em Salvar e Continuar para terminar a etapa dos escopos.
  9. Clique no botão Adicionar Usuários e adicione um e-mail de teste. Você pode adicionar seu próprio e-mail)
. hen finalmente clique em Salvar e Continuar para terminar a porção de Usuários Teste A.
  10. Vá para **Credenciais**. Clique no botão **Criar Credenciais** e selecione a opção **ID do cliente OAuth.
  11. Selecione o tipo de aplicativo como **Aplicativo Web** e preencha o campo Nome.
  12. Adicione https://cloud.activepieces.com/redirect no campo **URIs de redirecionamento autorizados** e clique no botão Criar.
  13. Copie o **ID do cliente** e o **Segredo do Cliente**.

pt.Removes a site from the set of the user': Remove um site do conjunto dos sites de busca do usuário.
pt.Use the URL Inspection action to check t: Use a ação Inspeção de URL para verificar o status e a presença de uma página específica no índice do Google.
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
pt.The start date of the date range to quer: A data de início do intervalo de datas a consultar (no formato AAAA-MM-DD).
pt.The end date of the date range to query: A data final do intervalo de data para consulta (no formato AAAA-MM-DD).
pt.The dimensions to group results by. Vali: As dimensões do grupo de resultados. Valores válidos: "consulta", "página", "pais", "dispositivo", "aparência", "aparência", "data", "hora".
pt.Filter results by search type. Defaults: Filtrar resultados por tipo de pesquisa. O padrão é "web".
pt.Optional filters to apply to the data. A: Filtros opcionais para aplicar aos dados. Todos os filtros são ANDS juntos.
pt.How data is aggregated. Defaults to \"au: Como os dados são agregados. O padrão é "auto".
pt.The maximum number of rows to return. Mi: Número máximo de linhas a retornar. Min: 1, Max: 5.000. O padrão é 1.000.
pt.Zero-based index of the first row to ret: Índice baseado em zero da primeira linha a retornar. Use com Limite de Linha para paginar resultados. O padrão é 0.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
